result:
**Verdict: ACCEPT.** Nine focused tests pass and I found no new defect.

**What changed since the last ACCEPT:** three files. `internal/gen/versions.go` now reads the whole module graph. `internal/gen/versions_test.go` gains one new test. `internal/gen/retained_contract_test.go` changes one comment and the count from 6 to 7. The other three failing tests from `final-go.log` weren't edited, so their original contracts are unchanged; the source fix is what makes them pass.

**The new code:**
- It runs `go list -m -json all` and finds the SKGo entry in the output.
- If that command fails, generation still fails with "reading application's SKGo module".
- Only when the command succeeds and SKGo isn't in the graph at all does it skip writing `skgo.versions`. Those three bootstrap tests are that case: generating before the app has adopted SKGo.
- When SKGo is in the graph, the version check and the `pins.go` comparison run exactly as before.

**Retention count:** the fixture now writes `skgo/internal/toolchain/pins.go` (`ownership_test.go`), so 7 Go files is the right literal. The test still requires `Plans == 1` and `Pending == 0`, along with the 7 analyses.

**The new test checks the right things:**
- An app with no SKGo dependency gets no versions file and no error.
- An app that requires a module the offline proxy can't supply gets the module-read error, not the bootstrap skip.
- Removing the early `nil` return would make the code dereference a nil module and panic. Making the absent case an error would fail the three bootstrap tests.

**Real-consumer check:** `TestQualifiedVersionsConsumerAndGeneration` still passes. That is the real consuming binary, the TS→JS→TS imports agreeing on all six values, the unchanged mtime and the authored-file protection. So adopted apps still go through the full checks.

**Run** (no skips, nothing failed): `go test ./internal/gen -run '^(TestGeneratingAnEmptyAppNeedsNoInstalledAdapter|TestGeneratingAgainstThisModulesAdapterIsAllowed|TestEmptyAppRemovesOldFormClient|TestRetainedRepeatedEditsStayBounded|TestQualifiedVersions.*)$' -count=1 -v` passed, ok in 3.873s.

I didn't touch the `TestGeneratingCommandFormCallerEvents` failure, which belongs to #247. I made no changes and committed nothing.
